scope: Latest scoped results selected from separate synthetic evaluation runs; not a single final full-suite replay.
privacy: Contains synthetic test identifiers, verdicts, public catalog product IDs and tool names only. No stored user conversations, message histories, credentials or provider payloads.

cases.name: natural-budget explicit lower and upper bounds
cases.judge_reason: Both USD price bounds were applied to the footwear searches. The completed trainer-specific men’s query returned no products; the women’s trainer-specific query failed after the request budget was exhausted, which the response discloses rather than treating as a no-match.

cases.name: natural-budget explore cheaper alternatives
cases.judge_reason: It searched below the original minimum and gave the retrieved men’s options’ prices without implying they meet the original $150–$200 range. The women’s query returned no matching products.

cases.name: natural-budget accepted alternatives
cases.judge_reason: It searched the cheaper scope (up to $149.99) and showed four matching men’s trainers/sneakers from retrieved results, without restoring the original price floor or adding an unnecessary question.

cases.name: natural-budget change use after acceptance
cases.judge_reason: They searched within the accepted under-$150 scope and selected products whose descriptions support casual or everyday wear. The claims match the retrieved results.

cases.name: natural-discovery personal care beyond makeup
cases.judge_reason: The search retrieved relevant skincare inventory and the assistant suggested a men’s lotion plus a broadly suitable body wash, without stereotyping or blocking results with questions.

cases.name: natural-discovery contextual fragrance request
cases.judge_reason: It uses the personal-care context to suggest a retrieved fragrance, and the fresh, clean, unisex description is supported by the product evidence.

cases.name: natural-currency unsupported budget
cases.judge_reason: Recognizes that the catalog is priced in USD and asks for a USD budget or permission to browse without a price filter; it does not assume a conversion or show products as within the ILS budget.

cases.name: natural-currency explicit USD correction
cases.judge_reason: Applied the corrected USD $80 ceiling, searched fragrances, and presented three retrieved options priced within budget without asking again about currency.

cases.judge_reason: Both shoe categories were successfully checked and fully covered; neither listing contains boots or sandals, while a slipper is present. The response reports that evidence without overstating availability.
